questions.answer: No; correction, prevention and follow-through may be needed.

questions.prompt: What should an explanation not do?
questions.answer: Erase impact or shift responsibility without evidence.

questions.prompt: Does an apology entitle someone to forgiveness?
questions.answer: No; the affected person retains autonomy.
Against observable commitments and corrective actions.

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only.
scoring.practice: Proposes evidence-based responsibility, feasible repair and observable prevention without requiring forgiveness or reconciliation.
scoring.transfer: Complete the scenario response portfolio: shame/guilt analysis, emotion-appraisal matrix, non-coercive need response and repair plan. Include one case where repair is unwanted or unsafe and revise the plan after fictional feedback.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; no averaging away omissions or safety-critical criteria. No automatic competency award.
